vBRIEFInfo.description: Story vBRIEF for #2112 (deferred back-compat removal of the vbrief read path); part of the #2034 decomposition.

plan.title: Remove the legacy vbrief read path after the back-compat window

narratives.Description: After at least one minor release of signposting, drop the legacy vbrief layout read path so xbrief becomes the sole supported layout. This story is independently buildable as a small resolver change plus tests, deferred behind the locked one-minor back-compat window and conditional on signposting having shipped.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Update the layout resolver module packages/core/src/xbrief-migrate/resolve-layout.ts to stop resolving the legacy vbrief tree and to emit a clear hard-stop pointing at migrate:xbrief. 2. Update resolve-layout.test.ts to assert the legacy tree now fails resolution with the migration hint and the xbrief tree resolves; confirm no remaining source path silently reads the legacy layout.
narratives.UserStory: As a directive maintainer, I want the legacy vbrief read path removed after the deprecation window, so that the engine resolves only the xbrief layout and unmigrated projects get a clear migration error.

items.title: Given an unmigrated tree, when the resolver runs, then it hard-stops with a migration hint

narrative.Acceptance: Given a project still on the legacy vbrief layout, when the resolver runs, then it fails and directs the operator to migrate:xbrief.

items.title: Given a migrated tree, when the resolver runs, then it resolves the xbrief layout cleanly

narrative.Acceptance: Given a migrated xbrief layout, when the resolver runs, then it resolves the artifacts without any legacy-path fallback.

items.title: Given the codebase, when scanned, then no source silently reads the legacy layout

narrative.Acceptance: Given the engine source, when scanned, then no remaining module reads the legacy vbrief tree without the migration hard-stop.

x-tracking.deferred: run no earlier than one minor release after consumer signposting ships

expected_outputs: legacy vbrief read path removed; resolver hard-stops unmigrated trees with a migrate:xbrief hint

references.title: Issue #2112: chore(vbrief): remove legacy vbrief read path after back-compat window
